mentions.name: Paradox Tower
mentions.description: A commercial puzzle game styled like a retro RPG, centered on finding the optimal path: players grab as many power-ups as possible to level up stats while avoiding monsters to conserve health. Inspired by the Magic Towers puzzle/RPG genre (similar to Desktop Dungeon, Soulestination, and Tactical Nexus), with a Steam page and a playable demo.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on my second commercial game. It's called Paradox Tower.

The game is meant to look like a retro RPG, but it's more of a puzzle about finding the optimal path. You must grab as many power ups as you can to level up your stats, while avoiding monsters to conserve your health.
mentions.author: zer0tonin
